Caption

Hook line construction

Weld the song hook (snake-cased to prose) to a craft verb (the action happening in cut 3) in one breath. End with the emoji stack that's been working for the previous reel so the audience reads series recognition.

SONG HOOK
{{song_hook_prose}} (e.g., "balling like the pacers")
CRAFT VERB
{{craft_verb_prose}} (e.g., "stitch by stitch")
EMOJI STACK
🪡🫡 — craft + salute, mirrors the on-frame hands
FOLD LEN
≤ 125 chars including emoji stack
  • ✅ Reads as one breath, not a fragment.
  • ✅ Song hook visibly references the audio track credit.
  • ✅ Closing triptych (No factory. No shortcuts. Just the process. Trust Yourself.) verbatim at body end.
  • ❌ Don't paraphrase the closing triptych — this IS the trust signal.

B-roll

Anchor cut 3 to the audio's chorus drop

The focal-action cut (3) is what carries both the cover frame AND the audio's emotional peak. Pace the reel so cut 3 lands on the chorus — every replay hits on the same beat, which is how the audience internalizes the song-as-build-music pattern.

  • ✅ Cut 3 covers focal action at peak tension — not mid-action, not pre-action.
  • ✅ Cut 3 is the cover-frame source — nail this shot even if the others are rough.
  • ✅ Cuts 1→3 fade UP into the chorus; cuts 4→5 drift DOWN after the peak.
  • ❌ Don't use the finished product flat-lay as any cut — IG suppresses it in Reels feed.

Pre-publish audit gate

Run this in the 30 seconds between "build ready" and tapping Post. Match row count + fail-action to the README recipe's gate table. Hard-gate rules fail Post. Soft notes don't.
#GateWhat good looks likeFail → fix
1.1 Title Reads <Product type> 1/1 exactly. No emoji in title. Stop. Rename. Only swap title to song hook if audio is unreleased snippet-only.
1.2 Title Matches last reel's series shape. Pick a series anchor from the last 2 reels and rename.
2.1 Caption hook Line 1 ≤ 125 chars. Lands song phrase + craft verb in one breath. Rewrite line 1 — pull song hook + action verb from the audio.
2.2 Caption body Closing triptych present verbatim: No factory. No shortcuts. Just the process. Trust Yourself. Restore verbatim from the recipe template.
2.3 Caption CTA Trust Yourself line + {{shop_url}} URL at the bottom. Append both.
2.4 PDP live {{shop_url}} returns 200, stock=1, price matches the caption. Hard-fix the PDP before posting. A 404 link makes the post a vibe post.
2.5 Hashtags First comment only. NOT inline in caption body. Move inline tags to the first comment within 5 sec of posting.
3.1 Timing — IG Inside the 6–8pm evening window. Not lunch, not midnight. Schedule for the next evening window.
3.2 Timing — FB Cross-post scheduled ≥ 48h after IG. Pull same-day FB; reschedule to the 48h slot.
4.1 Cover frame Process shot — focal action at peak tension. NOT a finished product flat-lay. Select a different frame from cut 3.
4.2 Cover text ≤ 4 words, all caps, bottom-right placement. Trim to ≤ 4 words. Force caps. Move to bottom-right.
4.3 Cover crop Square-safe: focal action in the middle horizontal band (1:1 grid crop safe). Re-crop. Center action vertically.
5.1 FB drift FB caption ≥ 10% drift from IG (one verb swap + one emoji swap minimum). Rewrite FB caption with two swaps minimum.
5.2 FB queued FB post scheduled in-platform at the 48h mark (not in a remember-later note). Queue it now in Facebook.
S.1 Audio uniqueness Audio track is NOT the same as the previous reel's audio. Pick fresh track. Reuse only if snippet is the value prop.
S.2 Hashtag count 7–10 tags in the first comment. Not 25+, not under 5. Trim or expand to the proven band.

Time budget: under 90 seconds. Going over → I'm arguing with myself on a row that already failed — drop back, repair, re-audit. Hard-gate rules fail Post. Soft notes don't gate but cause materially lower velocity if missed.
